evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of perioperative cardiac risk before planned elective
total knee arthroplasty.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 87 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 152 ms, QRS 101 ms, QTc
433 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with no acute ST-T wavechanges.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
50%. Mild aortic valve sclerosis without stenosis. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Mildly reduced left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 191 mg/dL
LDL Cholesterol: 96 mg/dL
HDL Cholesterol: 49 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 232 mg/dL (H)

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 136 mmol/L
Potassium: 4.2 mmol/L
Chloride: 98 mmol/L
CO2: 21 mmol/L
BUN: 25 mg/dL (H)
Creatinine: 1.4 mg/dL (H)
Glucose: 117 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 10.2 mg/dL

Amlodipine 5 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Levothyroxine 75 mcg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: comfortable at rest.
Neck: supplc, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, grade 2/6 systolic ejection
murmur, no radiation.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.

EXAM:
General: comfortable at rest.
Neck: supple, no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no carotid bruits.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.
